Reeled Codes (September 2026)

Updated Date : September 9, 2026

Reeled is a Roblox  fishing  game with a twist. Instead of simply waiting for a bite, you catch creatures and use weapons to take them down. The devs regularly release new codes that can help you get Coins and Gems to improve your equipment as you progress. If you don’t want to miss out, here’s the complete list of all the currently available codes.

Videogame guides

Last checked for new codes on: September 7, 2026

Active Reeled Codes (September 2026)

  • Dev – Redeem this code to get 100 Gems and 500 Coins.
  • TheBeginning – Redeem this code to get 100 Gems and 500 Coins.
  • WELCOME – Redeem this code to get 100 Gems and 500 Coins.
  • LeonSDH – Redeem this code to get 160 Gems and 1,600 Coins.

Expired Codes

  • There are no invalid codes as of now.

How to Redeem Reeled Codes

These are the simple steps to follow:

  • Launch Reeled on Roblox.
  • After the tutorial is complete, click on the Settings button with the cogwheel icon at the top.
  • Enter your code in the text box.
  • Click on Submit to receive the reward.

What Do Reeled Codes Give You?

The current codes provide two of the game’s main currencies, Coins and Gems. You can use these resources to improve your equipment and catch more fish without having to earn everything from scratch.

Videogame guides

Why is My Code Not Working?

Make sure the spelling and capitalization match the code listed above. These codes are case-sensitive, so even a small change can cause an error. Also check whether you have already used the code on your account because each code can only be redeemed once.

FAQs

What do Reeled codes give?

The active codes provide Gems and Coins that can be used to upgrade your equipment.

Does Reeled have an official Discord server?

Yes, there is an official Discord server where developers share game information, giveaways, and new code announcements.

If you’re looking for more interesting takes on the  Fishing game format and collect rewards while you’re at it, make sure to check out Deep Fishing codes.
